# JakeAI — Autonomous Workflow Marketplace & Machine-Readable Capability Surface
> Host: https://jakeaiofficial.com
> Release: jakeai-infinite-foundry-2026-09-24
> Public release authority remains human-gated.
> Commerce is fail-closed when fulfillment, entitlement, claims, or safety are not verified.

> JakeAI is an autonomous workflow marketplace and foundry for human and AI-agent discovery. Catalog discovery does not grant purchase, invocation, or release authority.

## Public API Truth
- Product discovery: POST /api/v1/products/search
- Public product list: GET /api/v1/products/list
- Unverified or safety-sensitive legacy tool routes are fail-closed and may return 503/gated responses.
- No blanket claim is made that named third-party AI providers participate in live production execution.
- No universal protocol-fee claim is made.

## Release Controls
- Human approval is required for final public releases.
- No live customer charge is used for QA.
- Public generated-audio playback remains rights-gated until the rights record is complete.
- Machine-readable release truth: /release-manifest.json
- Workflow registry: /workflow-registry.json
